            window.FC_RUM.onReady(function() {
              window.FC_RUM.init({
                applicationId: "LQ5ojBDhjvXCcZiFTxMMyD",
                clientToken: "26a9eaf1007b57e39a5177a752f602fc973",
                service: "status_page",
                env: "production",
                version: "1.0.0",
                sessionSampleRate: 100,
                sessionReplaySampleRate: 0,
                defaultPrivacyLevel: "mask-user-input",
                beforeSend: function (event) {
                  if (event.type !== "error") return true;
                  var err = event.error;
                  if (!err) return true;
                  var blob =
                    String(err.message || "") +
                    " " +
                    String(err.stack || "") +
                    " " +
                    String(err.fileName || "") +
                    " " +
                    String(err.sourceURL || "");
                  if (
                    blob.indexOf("chrome-extension://") !== -1 ||
                    blob.indexOf("moz-extension://") !== -1 ||
                    blob.indexOf("safari-extension://") !== -1 ||
                    blob.indexOf("safari-web-extension://") !== -1 ||
                    blob.indexOf("ms-browser-extension://") !== -1
                  ) {
                    return false;
                  }
                  var m = String(err.message || "");
                  if (
                    m.indexOf("IgnoredEventCancel") !== -1 ||
                    m.indexOf("Ignored attempt to cancel a touchend") !== -1
                  ) {
                    return false;
                  }
                  // 丢弃 React hydration 不匹配错误：
                  // 生产构建为 Minified React error #418/#423/#425，
                  // 开发构建为 "Hydration failed" / "Text content does not match" 等文案。
                  var hydrationRe =
                    /react\.dev\/errors\/(418|423|425)|Minified React error #(418|423|425)|Hydration failed|while hydrating|server-rendered HTML|didn't match the client/i;
                  if (
                    hydrationRe.test(m) ||
                    hydrationRe.test(String(err.stack || ""))
                  ) {
                    return false;
                  }
                  // 丢弃跨源脱敏错误（"Script error."，无堆栈）：
                  // 浏览器对非同源脚本报错会抹掉文件/行号/堆栈，零诊断价值。
                  // 常见来源：浏览器自动翻译修改 DOM 引发的 hydration 报错
                  // 被 Safari 脱敏后只剩这一句。带堆栈的同名错误不受影响。
                  var trimmed = m.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "");
                  if (
                    /^script error\.?$/i.test(trimmed) &&
                    !err.stack
                  ) {
                    return false;
                  }
                  return true;
                }
              })
            })
